[image: Hampton Roads is the region of the country most affected by the changing climate. Last week’s nor’easter showed us yet again that we need to be working on this NOW, and not let the deniers slow us down. There is no avoiding it - every single city in Hampton Roads is facing increased flooding, beach erosion, and more. We need to act now and act together. #wollforcongress #VA03 #hamptonroadsva][image: Hampton Roads is the region of the country most affected by the changing climate. [image: I had a great time at the Neptune Shield SEAL Tank business pitch competition last night in Virginia Beach, featuring exciting new companies from across Hampton Roads and in fact across the country! It was great to reconnect with startup leaders like Tim Ryan and Zack Miller from Innovate Hampton Roads (@innovate_757), who I have known for years. Even more exciting, I met other folks helping foster small businesses in the region, including Donna Norman from the Hampton Roads Small Business Development Center (@hamptonroadssbdc) and Tonya Fentress from the Slover Library (@thesloverstrategist), who helps harness the Slover's significant capabilities for small businesses. Small businesses create the majority of new jobs in the U.S. and are a path to the financial stability and success that so many Americans feel is out of reach. I'm going to fight to tackle cost of living challenges for our citizens and to help small businesses any way we can. For more information, please visit https://www.stevewoll.com to learn about my goals and strategies. #HamptonRoads #VA03 #wollforcongress][image: I had a great time at the Neptune Shield SEAL Tank business pitch competition last night in Virginia Beach, featuring exciting new companies from across Hampton Roads and in fact across the country!
